# v2026.10.28

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- The job board shows work stages, and Seazona lines find their price item and customer. ([#93](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/93))
- The sidebar folds, and its foot shows who is signed in. ([#94](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/94), [#97](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/97))

## Changes

- Sidebar foot shows who is signed in, with Search; Report a problem moves into the account menu. ([#94](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/94))
- Workspace-first Replit updates; Seazona lines find their price item and jobs their customer; job board by work stage. ([#93](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/93))
- Menu button folds the sidebar; Report a problem gets its own row. ([#97](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/97))
